metrics.method: Full history 2025-07-24 to 2026-08-26: 977 non-service messages (Eli 482 as the sole client alias per config/clients.yaml; 495 from ALTR staff and partners per config/team.yaml). Questions = runs of consecutive Eli messages with no team message in between, counted as one turn if any message in the run contains '?' → 58 turns. unanswered_over_24h counted by manually reading each of the 58 turns for a substantive, on-topic reply from any non-client sender within 24h; a script keying on 'next team message of any kind' gives 8, but that credits unrelated invoice chatter and bare @-tags as answers, so the manual figure (15) is used and includes 5 questions never substantively answered at all (Michelle's role 2025-09-08, the Guada OF collab upload 2025-10-22, the IG 'not recommended' report 2026-03-17, the unknown OF login 2026-03-18, and the 2026-08-26 wire-bounce disclosure still open at export). max_team_silence_days = longest gap between consecutive non-client messages, 2026-05-05 14:40 to 2026-06-01 14:28. Promises = explicit 'I will / we will / we're finalizing' commitments by ALTR staff or partners, counted once per distinct item (recurring behaviour such as issuing split payment links on request counted once); kept if delivery is visible in chat, lapsed if there is no delivery and no follow-up.
